sources.label: Plesa et al., Nature Aging — October 14, 2026; published research

research.summary: A new season of colour passes through a face that keeps its history. Inspired by experiments in cultured human fibroblasts: inducing the RNA-processing factor SRSF1 shifted ageing-related readouts while largely preserving tested fibroblast identity markers. The effects depended on induction timing and duration. Conceptual art, not evidence of rejuvenation in people.
